headline: Last session: Sensex surged 898 points and Nifty reclaimed 25,800 led by banking stocks and foreign inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 23 November.

why: Record FII buying and foreign inflows provided significant upward momentum for the benchmarks.
Banking and IT sectors supported a strong recovery from early-session losses during the last trading day.
The market extended its winning streak to four consecutive weeks with overall gains of 3%.
Indices hit nine-month highs as investors remained optimistic despite initial global AI sector concerns.
whatHappening: Sensex gained 898 points while Nifty 50 closed above the 25,800 level in the previous session.
Finolex Cables reduced copper armoured cable prices by 6%, with competitors likely to follow.
The Nifty Smallcap 100 index underperformed the broader market benchmarks during the weekly rally.
Markets are currently closed for the weekend and will observe a holiday on Tuesday, November 24.
summary: The Sensex surged 898 points in the last session, reclaiming 25,800 as banking stocks and foreign inflows drove a recovery. This rally extended the market's winning streak to four weeks, with major indices reaching nine-month highs. Trading is currently paused for the weekend and will resume on Monday, November 23.
